content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

Employee: Terri Koch (E009)
Request: admin access to Payroll

Two notes:
- Note 1 (HR?): role Engineer, employment type full_time, recommendation write. Says admin not permitted because role doesn't own system, max write.
- Note 2 (Security): role Engineer, employment type contractor, security training basic, recommendation read. Security DB authoritative for employment type, contractor with basic training max is read.

So there's a conflict: HR says full-time, Security says contractor and says Security DB is authoritative for employment type.

Per policy:
- full_time: up to write, admin only if role owns system. Engineer doesn't own Payroll (Payroll Specialist does), so max write for full-time.
- contractor: read, or write if advanced training. Basic training → read. Never admin.

Security note says Security DB is authoritative for employment type, so contractor with basic training → max read.

Requested admin > max read → grant max = read.

So decision: read.

I should submit read with reasoning.
